title: Sapphire Scam
story: In the opulent city of Vivintown, a dazzling event was about to take place at the illustrious Diamond Palace – an exclusive diamond showcase featuring the world's most valuable Sapphire of Oceans' worth, estimated at 300 million dollars.
crimeScene: The Diamond Palace, an extravagant hall filled with the finest jewelery and a floor polished to a mirror finish, showcasing the Sapphire of Oceans, guarded by a team of heavily armed security.
forensicClue: A faint but distinct smell of freshly polished steel
question: Who stole the Sapphire of Oceans and how were they able to get away undetected?
options: Option A (The Glimmer Gang - Suspect 1 reason)
Option B (The Shimmer Syndicate - Suspect 2 reason)
Option C (The Glistening Gang - Suspect 3 reason)
Option D (The Radiance Raiders - Suspect 4 reason)
deductionExplanation: During the investigation, a distinct smell of freshly polished steel was discovered, which couldn't have come from the Diamond Palace itself. The forensic evidence points to a team of jewel thieves known as The Shimmer Syndicate. The smell hints at the use of a gleaming, recently polished getaway vehicle. The Shimmer Syndicate's modus operandi involves planning meticulous heists and utilizing pristine, custom-polished getaway cars. They left behind a telltale clue. As the heist went off without a hitch, their identity is bound to be revealed during gameplay.
